# Support

## Getting Help

Here are the best ways to get help with `@interlace/serverless` packages:

### 📚 Documentation

- **Main README**: [README.md](../README.md) — overview, install, quick start
- **Docs site**: <https://serverless.interlace.tools> — install, config reference, CLI commands, migration guides
- **Contributing Guide**: [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) — how to contribute
- **Per-package READMEs**: see `packages/*/README.md` (each package documents its own config + CLI surface)
- **AI Agent Guides**: see `packages/*/AGENTS.md` for LLM-optimized documentation

### 🐛 Bug Reports

Found a bug? Please open an issue using our [bug report template](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml).

**Before reporting:**

- Search existing issues to avoid duplicates
- Check the documentation site for usage answers
- Provide a minimal reproduction case (a `serverless.yml` / `serverless.ts` snippet + the command + the observed log)
- Include environment details (Node.js version, Serverless Framework version, plugin version, OS)

### ✨ Feature Requests

Have an idea? Use our [feature request template](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml).

When proposing a new feature, please describe:

- The use case (what are you trying to achieve?)
- Why existing config / CLI surface doesn't cover it
- Whether you'd like to contribute the implementation

### 💬 Discussions

For questions, ideas, or general discussion:

- [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/ofri-peretz/serverless/discussions)

### 📧 Direct Contact

- **GitHub Issues**: [Open an issue](https://github.com/ofri-peretz/serverless/issues/new/choose)
- **Email**: <ofriperetzdev@gmail.com>

## Response Times

- **Critical bugs** (resource leaks, ghost billing, deploy-blockers): within 24–48 hours
- **Feature requests**: reviewed weekly
- **General questions**: best effort, typically within a week

## Community Guidelines

- Be respectful and constructive
- Provide context when asking questions
- Search existing issues / discussions before posting
- Follow our [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

## Contributing

We welcome contributions! See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for details — the workflow is branch from `main`, write tests (≥ 90% coverage required for published source), open a PR, merge after review.
